brief:
Israeli occupation forces established military checkpoints across several areas of Bethlehem governorate Saturday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. The deployment took place as security operations continued throughout the West Bank territory. Checkpoints were positioned at multiple locations within the governorate, restricting movement and access in the affected zones.

Settlers simultaneously carried out provocative patrols in the region during the same period. The combined operations—involving both military checkpoints and settler activities—marked an intensification of pressure on Palestinian residents. The specific locations of individual checkpoints and the exact extent of the patrol routes were not detailed in initial reports of the incident.
